description.value: An RV-oriented park on the river in Oliver, off Highway 97, with full hookups, showers, and internet in the heart of South Okanagan wine country; no tent sites are listed, so cycle tourers seeking a pitch may find limited options here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at ezcampground.com is functional and confirms this is 'EZ RV Park' in Oliver, BC — a name that differs from OSM's 'EZ Campground'. The website explicitly confirms water, electricity, high-speed internet, coin laundry, showers, a clubhouse, and a reservations workflow; OSM tags (internet_access=yes, power_supply=yes) are consistent. No tent or hiker/biker sites are mentioned anywhere on the site, and all site descriptions reference RV hookups, leaving the property's suitability for non-RV touring cyclists unconfirmed.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'EZ Campground' but the website consistently and exclusively uses 'EZ RV Park' on all pages.
Phone number 1-888-921-1119 is sourced from the website contact page only; OSM has no phone field to cross-check.
No street address found in OSM tags or anywhere on the website (contact page map embed did not produce readable address text).
No tent sites, walk-in sites, or hiker/biker sites are mentioned anywhere on the site; all accommodation language references RV spots and hookups.
Website copyright reads 2022 — content may be outdated; amenity details should be verified directly with the operator.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The property is exclusively RV-focused with no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation; it is unclear whether touring cyclists without RVs can be accommodated, which is a fundamental requirement for a WWC cycling directory listing.

wow_evidence: exclusively RV-focused with no mention of tent sites or hiker/biker accommodation
